revision.reason: REVISE_REQUIRED_LOW_EFFORT: predecessor cadence was metadata-correct but visibly equalized and under-authored.
revision.repair_goal: make the inertial join readable through asymmetric coil, support-load shock, catch, overshoot, secondary lag, and recovery debt without re-keying merely because the parent translates

source.name: Dr Robuttnik (Elevator)

axis_separation.temporal: rider local load-bearing state and authored response
axis_separation.parent_transform: platform world translation/acceleration is an independent clock channel
axis_separation.variant_configuration: source presentation/configuration differences do not establish chronology

rig_schema.description: independently authored abstract ASCII biped riding an abstract moving platform

clock_channels.rule: world translation and support acceleration may update while a rider-local decisive key remains held
re-key only for authored local state or materially changed support-load relationship

timing_doctrine.shorthand: 1s/2s/4s means ONES/TWOS/FOURS timing classes, never seconds

compile.bridge_policy: deterministic quadratic arc within unchanged support topology only; bridges carry no new semantic labels
compile.platform_profile: accelerate/cruise -> brake ramp -> decel shock -> loaded drag -> zero-accel release -> cruise

keys.name: CRUISE_CARRY
keys.motion_arc_root_note: local root quiet and slightly loaded; parent translates +X at steady cruise while rider key remains unchanged
keys.causal_role: stable carry proves parent translation does not spend rider-local timing bandwidth

bridge_to_next.purpose: coil preparation only; no new semantic state

keys.name: ASYMMETRIC_PRE_BRAKE_COIL
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; heels planted, left knee carries more compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM drops down-left against impending support deceleration; left side compresses while right arm opens forward
keys.causal_role: authored anticipation/coil makes the incoming inertial event legible before peak load

bridge_to_next.purpose: fast release from coil into support-load shock

keys.name: DECEL_SHOCK
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; feet unchanged, load spikes toward forefoot
keys.motion_arc_root_note: support deceleration spikes; pelvis lags less than chest/head, producing forward shear without changing foot topology
keys.causal_role: INERTIAL_JOIN impact emphasis: material support-load change earns a local re-key

bridge_to_next.purpose: impact collapses into catch rather than reversing toward the coil

keys.name: LOW_CATCH
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; deep bilateral catch, left knee more compressed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM drops after shock; knees absorb load while torso remains ahead of pelvis
keys.causal_role: catch converts shock into grounded resistance and prevents an unreadable one-frame snap-back

bridge_to_next.purpose: compress catch into sustained loaded brace

keys.name: LOADED_BRACE_HOLD
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; same feet, sustained forward shear carried through bent knees
keys.motion_arc_root_note: local brace freezes for readability while PLATFORM_CLOCK continues changing position under sustained deceleration
keys.causal_role: readable loaded hold demonstrates parent/local clock separation under continuing world motion

keys.name: RELEASE_OVERSHOOT
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; feet remain planted as shear drops
keys.motion_arc_root_note: when support acceleration returns toward zero, stored brace releases past neutral; chest leads left while feet stay attached
keys.causal_role: overshoot prevents endpoint interpolation and gives the brake event a consequence

bridge_to_next.purpose: root begins recovery while upper chain remains delayed

keys.name: UPPER_CHAIN_LAG
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; lower body recenters before head/right arm
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis begins returning but head and distal right arm lag one beat behind, preserving directional history
keys.causal_role: secondary lag separates root recovery from upper-chain recovery

bridge_to_next.purpose: lag dissipates into a visibly indebted stance

keys.name: RECOVERY_DEBT
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; bilateral stance recovered but left side remains more compressed
keys.motion_arc_root_note: COM recenters incompletely; head/shoulder line retains residual left bias instead of resetting to idle
keys.causal_role: recovery debt keeps force history visible after acceleration has ended

bridge_to_next.purpose: debt resolves toward a new cruise stance, not the opening pose

keys.name: CRUISE_AFTER_DEBT
keys.support_contact: BILATERAL_PLATFORM_CONTACT; planted, residual shoulder asymmetry retained
keys.motion_arc_root_note: platform returns to constant velocity; local body is stable but not byte-for-byte idle reset
keys.causal_role: settled consequence closes the phrase while preserving a trace of the event
